methods.documented_intro: The method allows you to submit (register) a fulfillment delivery in draft or packing status. Products are treated as packed in simple packing mode and the shipment is registered in the fulfillment center. Optionally accepts date_arrival (unix timestamp) as the expected arrival date when required by the fulfillment integration. Currently supported for selected fulfillment integrations with simple packing mode.

parameters.name: date_arrival
parameters.documented_description: (optional) Expected arrival date at the fulfillment center (unix timestamp). Required by some integrations that need a planned receipt date (e.g. DHL Fulfillment).

required_when.condition: integration requires a planned receipt date
